turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Sure. Let me think aloud with an example: "In 2020 we ___ (buy) a car."
Step 1: 2020 is in the past, so I need a past verb.
Step 2: "buy" is an irregular verb, so I don't add -ed. I use its own past form: "bought".
Result: "In 2020 we bought a car."
Rule: irregular verbs don't take -ed; they have their own past form.
Right: "We ate fish." Wrong: "We eated fish."
Now you try. Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
